label: List
job: Turn a curated set of family activities/events into a highly scannable social post.
dominantVisualIdea: Strong editorial headline followed by a rhythmic numbered list that remains useful at feed size.

clean.dominantIdea: An editorial index: dark type on paper, restrained number tabs and fine rules.
clean.spacing: Header-connected list, generous margins and calm vertical rhythm.
clean.numberTreatment: Small two-digit index on a teal tab.
clean.headlineBehaviour: Full width, left aligned, measured natural wrapping.
clean.density: One column normally; two beyond eight items.

playful.dominantIdea: Expressive teal header with a coloured route, leading into an offset paper list.
playful.hierarchy: High contrast headline with accent ending; bold items anchored by coloured numbers.
playful.spacing: Alternating bounded offsets in one column; fixed safe gutters in two.
playful.numberTreatment: Large colourful blocks create a structural colour rhythm.
playful.headlineBehaviour: Larger type, reserved route gutter, coloured final word.
playful.graphicBehaviour: Flat route arrow owns the header gutter; a pink rail connects into the list.
playful.density: One column normally; two beyond eight items.

poster.dominantIdea: A yellow typographic header with a bleeding count, over a teal numbered poster.
poster.hierarchy: Oversized headline/count → oversized number rhythm → useful names/metadata.
poster.spacing: Asymmetric header and stretched number rhythm in the body.
poster.numberTreatment: Oversized plain numerals; the count bleeds at the left edge of the header.
poster.headlineBehaviour: Highest scale, left count gutter and naturally wrapped text.
poster.graphicBehaviour: Diagonal pink band and full-bleed teal body; orange footer.
poster.density: Two columns from five items, supported above explicit readability floors.

graphicCapabilities.behaviour: Owned by each composition rule; no arbitrary placement.

limits.onFailure: Report infeasible; never hide semantic rows or shrink below the floor.
